model: Orbital Economy v7.7.6 Ore Capital candidate r1
note: Task 019 fragment. All numeric constants introduced by the Ore Mine simple_capital declaration are annotated, including the intentionally asymmetric A/B initial capacities 70/28. Reviewer merges accepted entries into the canonical registry.

Ore Capital Enabled.role: Ore-mining simple-capital master switch, raw value 1.
Ore Capital Enabled.effect: 0 preserves accepted Modes 0-39 exactly; 1 makes effective mining capacity read ore-mine capital and enables mine expansion, depreciation, retirement, and backing-resource sinks.

Ore Mine Capacity Reserve Factor.effect: Scales the smoothed Ore Demand Signal into desired mine capacity.

Ore Mine Construction Time.role: Ore-mine capacity construction time, value 90 days.
Ore Mine Construction Time.effect: Divides the positive capacity gap to set desired expansion speed before backing-resource coverage limits it.

Ore Mine Retirement Time.role: Ore-mine capacity surplus retirement time, value 360 days.
Ore Mine Retirement Time.effect: Controls removal rate of capacity above desired capacity.

Ore Mine Depreciation Rate.role: Ore-mine capacity depreciation rate, value 0.0001 per day.
Ore Mine Depreciation Rate.effect: Applies continuous physical attrition to Ore Mine Capacity while the mechanic is enabled.

Ore Mine Capital Goods per Capacity.role: Capital Goods requirement per unit of new ore-mine capacity, value 0.5.
Ore Mine Capital Goods per Capacity.effect: Scales Desired Expansion into Capital Goods demand and actual expansion into Capital Goods consumption.

Ore Mine Construction Materials per Capa.role: Construction Materials requirement per unit of new ore-mine capacity, value 0.5.
Ore Mine Construction Materials per Capa.effect: Scales Desired Expansion into Construction Materials demand and actual expansion into Construction Materials consumption.

A Ore Mine Capacity.role: Initial simple-capital ore-mine capacity for colony A, value 70.
A Ore Mine Capacity.effect: Seeds mine capacity at the accepted A Mining Capacity; A/B are intentionally asymmetric (70 vs 28).
A Ore Mine Capacity.evidence: TASK_RU §2 and V7_7_6_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §0–§2 explicitly require A=70, B=28.

B Ore Mine Capacity.role: Initial simple-capital ore-mine capacity for colony B, value 28.
B Ore Mine Capacity.effect: Seeds mine capacity at the accepted B Mining Capacity; A/B are intentionally asymmetric (70 vs 28).
B Ore Mine Capacity.evidence: TASK_RU §2 and V7_7_6_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §0–§2 explicitly require A=70, B=28.

Ore Demand Signal Adjustment Time.role: Ore demand-signal adjustment time, value 3 days.
Ore Demand Signal Adjustment Time.effect: Controls lag from Positive Desired Mining Rate to the STOCK signal used for mine sizing and avoids same-step demand feedback.
Ore Demand Signal Adjustment Time.evidence: V7_7_6_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §1–§2; simple_capital STOCK sizing rule in lab/docs/NODES_RU.md.

A Ore Demand Signal.role: Initial smoothed ore-demand signal for colony A, value 25.
A Ore Demand Signal.effect: Seeds the STOCK sizing signal; the shared initial value intentionally differs from A's actual starting demand and converges with a 3-day adjustment time.

B Ore Demand Signal.role: Initial smoothed ore-demand signal for colony B, value 25.
B Ore Demand Signal.effect: Seeds the STOCK sizing signal; the shared initial value intentionally differs from B's actual starting demand and causes only the documented startup transient.
